0022600024.text: The Phoenix Suns (1-2, 0-2 on the road but 1-0 at home) host the Denver Nuggets (2-2) in this Emirates NBA Cup West Group A matchup, with Phoenix on a one-game losing streak and Denver on a one-game winning streak. Phoenix is 3rd in the Pacific and 11th in the West, 2 games back in its division, while Denver is 4th in the Northwest and 9th in the West, 1.5 games back; Phoenix is without Mark Williams (out, shoulder surgery) and Oso Ighodaro (day-to-day, oblique strain, game-time decision), and Denver is without Alpha Diallo (out, personal), Cameron Johnson (out, ankle sprain), Julian Strawther (out, knee sprain), and Spencer Jones (out, hamstring). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Suns lost all three meetings, including a 125-123 home loss on March 24, 2026.
